g.text: Find your way at Burnaby Hospital
on Level 1 to travel between the Health Care Pavilion and
to enter Burnaby Hospital from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.
only access Health Care Pavilion levels.
: From 10 p.m. until 6 a.m., no public entry
into the Health Care Pavilion. Please use the Emergency Entrance.
